label: Starsector sandboxes
description: How Starsector sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: mo2.

notes: Enable mods in the Starsector launcher's Mods tab after deploying - being in the folder is not enough.
Archives are unpacked flat into mods, so the zip must already contain the mod's own folder (with mod_info.json inside it), which is how Starsector mods are normally packaged.
Saves are in the saves folder of the game directory.
Hard links are the default: nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod, and every file is still a real file to the game.

presets.label: Clean
presets.description: Nothing deployed - the vanilla game, for checking whether a bug is yours.

options.label: Additional launch arguments
options.description: Passed verbatim. One argument per space; nothing here goes through a shell.
